title: 先保护，再停下

source.prompt: TrackType: Music, VocalType: Instrumental. Original instrumental retro fantasy tactical RPG score. Clear memorable NEW melody, compact four-voice counterpoint, warm pulse-wave lead, rounded triangle bass, gentle acoustic chamber colors, restrained noise percussion, clean mobile-speaker mix. No vocals, no choir, no speech, no lyrics; no quotation or imitation of any existing melody. 136 BPM, weighty tactical march facing former allies and protecting a dangerous tower. Firm midrange brass-like melody, minor-key strings and short pulse countermelody; difficult responsibility rather than simple villain music. Controlled dynamics, no massive orchestral wall. Maintain steady repeating musical phrases throughout, no long introduction, no fade-out or final ending.
source.negative_prompt: vocals, singing, speech, lyrics, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, loud sound effects, abrupt stop

editing.method: four-bar-multiple pulse alignment and two-beat chroma/timbre/energy window search; cosine equal-gain overlap

rhythm.note: Algorithmic pulse estimate; musical beat/meter and perceived loop coherence require listening.
